name: SprintCards show pending notifications
description:
1. You asked to surface **unread messages** on SprintCards so unread cards are easy to spot while scanning a board.
2. I explored the codebase and found the existing "unread" rule already used in `ChatSidebarNodeExtended.vue` (assistant message, from another user, not in `read_by`, not hidden).
3. I proposed changes to a single file, `src/components/kanban/board/SprintTaskCard.vue`, requiring no store or service changes.
4. The update adds two signals: a red border/tint on the whole card and a solid `badge-error` with envelope icon + count (`99+` cap) in the title row.
5. Accessibility was handled by pairing icon + count + `aria-label` with color, and unread (`error`) was kept visually distinct from the existing pending badge (`info`).

messages.content: Show unread messages in the SprintCards, make them clear so we can find cards that we haven't read yet.

I'll analyze the task and explore the codebase to understand the patterns for unread message tracking. ``` Search completed: 4 queries executed, 40 documents found ``` Let me explore the board directory and the chats service to understand existing unread patterns. ``` Search completed: 4 queries executed, 40 documents found ``` Let me find the chats service and the board subdirectory files. ``` Read 1 file(s) | Successfully read: src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardColumn.vue | Failed to read 2 file(s): src/service/chats.js, src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoard.vue ``` Let me find the chats service and related helper files. ``` Search completed: 5 queries executed, 50 documents found ``` ``` Read 0 file(s) | Failed to read 1 file(s): ["src/service/service.js", "src/service/chats.js"] ``` Let me locate the chats service and understand how `$chats` helper methods are registered. ``` Search completed: 4 queries executed, 40 documents found ``` Let me read the service files to understand the `$chats` service helpers used in the card. ``` Read 3 file(s) | Successfully read: src/service/chat.js, src/service/index.js, src/service/service.js ``` Let me read the full chats store to see all getters and helpers. ``` Read 1 file(s) | Successfully read: src/store/chats.js ``` I now have a complete understanding. Let me analyze the request. ## 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking **Core Requirements** - The `SprintTaskCard.vue` cards (used on sprint/kanban boards) must clearly reveal when a card has **unread** messages, so users can scan a board and instantly find cards they haven't reviewed yet. **Current State (what already exists)** - `ChatSidebarNodeExtended.vue` already implements an **unread** definition: an assistant message, authored by someone other than the current user, **not** present in `read_by`, and not hidden. - The store already persists this via `read_by` (see `markMessageAsSeen` and the `Message.read_by` field in `model/chat.ts`). - `RecentChatsQuickAccess.vue` uses a solid `bg-error` badge for unread — a design precedent I'll follow. - `SprintTaskCard.vue` already has a "pending" (`bg-info`) badge, which is a **different** concept (awaiting answer), so unread must be visually distinct. **Strategic Approach** - Reuse the exact unread rule from `ChatSidebarNodeExtended.vue` so the notion of "unread" stays consistent across the app. - Add two complementary signals (per scanning UX best practice): 1. **Card-level highlight** — a red border/ring + subtle tint so unread cards pop in the column. 2. **A solid `badge-error` with envelope icon + count** in the title row (never color alone). - Keep the change self-contained to the one file (matches how the sidebar does it). **Dependencies & Risks** - `task.messages` may only carry the last message until fully loaded (same caveat already documented for `messageCount`). The unread count is therefore optimistic on first paint and self-corrects on reload — acceptable and consistent with existing behaviour. - `selected` styling must take precedence over the unread highlight. - `$user.username` is available as a global (`this.$user`), as used in `ChatSidebarNodeExtended.vue`. **Target Files** - Modify: `src/components/kanban/board/SprintTaskCard.vue` ## 2. Minimum Changes Approach One file, one section. No store/service changes required — the unread rule is derived from data already present on the chat object. ## 3. File changes, Code Block Formatting & Proposed Changes ```vue src/components/kanban/board/SprintTaskCard.vue ``` ## 4. File Change Summary Table | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintTaskCard.vue` | Modify | `computed` | Added `unreadCount`, `hasUnread`, `unreadTitle` — reuses the exact unread rule from `ChatSidebarNodeExtended.vue` (assistant message, from another user, not in `read_by`, not hidden). | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintTaskCard.vue` | Modify | `
` `:class` | Added an unread state: `border-error/50 bg-error/5 ring-1 ring-error/20 hover:border-error/70`, applied only when not `selected` (selected styling still wins). | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintTaskCard.vue` | Modify | Title row | Added a solid `badge-error` with envelope icon + count (`99+` cap), with `title`/`aria-label` for accessibility (never color-only). | ### Design rationale (WCAG AA) - **Not color-only:** the unread signal pairs an **icon (`fa-envelope`) + numeric count + text label** with the red border, so it's perceivable without relying on the color channel. - **Distinct semantics:** unread uses `error` (attention), while the pre-existing "pending" badge keeps `info` — no ambiguity between "unread" and "awaiting answer". - **Hierarchy:** the unread badge (`badge-sm`, solid) is slightly more prominent than the outline `badge-xs` priority chip, drawing the eye first while scanning a column. - **Consistency:** matches the unread color convention already used in `RecentChatsQuickAccess.vue` and keeps the unread definition identical to the chat sidebar.
